Type
Council meetings
Address

2101 Innisfil Beach Rd, Innisfil

Innisfil Town Council is holding a regular meeting of Council. Join in person at Town Hall (Council Chambers) or livestream the meeting online on the Town's YouTube channel. 

Visit our CivicWeb platform to see what's on the agenda and how you can speak at the meeting.
